notes: Primary source: Linea Research official 48M series datasheet/brochure PDF (E&OE AUGUST2019 V1.7), cross-checked against linea-research.co.uk product page and multiple AV retailers (Full Compass, Audio Life, GoKnight). The 48M20 is the flagship 8-channel model in the 48M family (48M03/48M06/48M10/48M20), sharing one chassis and rear-panel layout across the range - only output power differs. Speaker outputs: 8 amplifier channels are delivered via 4 physical Speakon NL4 connectors (2 channels per connector, standard NL4 pinout 1+/1- and 2+/2-); each can also be configured for bridged mono operation per pair. "Aux Port" is visible on the rear-panel diagram (small connector near Dante/Ethernet block, labeled "AUX PORT") but its exact connector type/pinout is not detailed in the datasheet text - mapped to euroblock as the closest fit; treat with lower confidence than the rest of the port list. Dante ports are a factory-fitted option, not present on every unit as shipped (non-Dante base units lack the two RJ45 Dante ports but retain the separate Ethernet control port). No AES3/Dante/Ethernet ports carry a stated line-rate spec beyond "network" in the datasheet, so eth-1g grade on RJ45 ports is inferred (standard for Dante-capable devices of this era, not explicitly confirmed in the source). Mains connector confirmed via Neutrik as powerCON (32A), single-phase, non-IEC locking connector - closest available id in the enum is "powercon". Enclosure: 19" 2U (88mm) rack, 357mm deep, 12.5kg net weight.
